notes: Classroom can now be read without any of Google's permissions: sign in to Google in a window, the way you would in a browser, and mangoclass reads your to-do list off Classroom's own pages. No Cloud project, no consent screen, nothing for the school to approve. Also: both panes can now save the page they were reading, so a school whose portal doesn't look like anyone else's can be fixed properly instead of guessed at.
